course.title: Water Resources Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A stream of 150 lit/sec was diverted from a canal and 120 lit/sec were delivered (10) to the field. An area of 2.0 hectors was irrigated in 7 hr. The effective depth of root zone is 1.8m. The runoff loss in the field was $4 5 0 m ^ { 3 }$ The depth of water penetration varied linearly from 1.8m at the head end of the field to 1.2m at the tail end. Available moisture holding capacity of soil is 25cm per m depth of soil. Irrigation was started at a moisture extraction level of 45% of available moisture. Determine $\mathsf { n } _ { \mathsf { c } } ,$ Na, ηs and ηd.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
